title: Worker build fails to resolve node:crypto or node:buffer even though Workers support Node APIs
symptoms: Wrangler build says the package wasn't found on the file system but is built into node
A dependency that imports node:stream breaks the deploy
cause: Node.js built ins are only available when the nodejs_compat flag is on. It became a default only for compatibility dates of 2026-08-04 or later, so Workers with older dates must add the flag by hand.
fix: Add nodejs_compat to compatibility_flags, or move compatibility_date to 2026-08-04 or later after testing other date gated changes.
affected: Workers with compatibility_date before 2026-08-04 and no nodejs_compat flag
